description: This file contains React hooks and utility functions for UI state management, measurements, string formatting, settings handling, and other helper utilities used in a web application.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Class managing application settings with persistent storage and change notifications.

methods.name: useAsyncMemo
methods.description: Recalculates the value when dependencies change, handling asynchronous computations.

methods.name: useMeasure
methods.description: Tracks the bounding box of a DOM element.

methods.name: useMeasureForRef
methods.description: Recalculates the bounding box for a given ref.

methods.name: msToString
methods.description: Converts milliseconds to a human-readable string.

methods.name: bytesToString
methods.description: Converts byte counts to a human-readable string.

methods.name: lowerBound
methods.description: Performs a binary search to find the lower bound index in a sorted array.

methods.name: upperBound
methods.description: Performs a binary search to find the upper bound index in a sorted array.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copies text to clipboard using a temporary textarea element.

methods.name: useSetting
methods.description: Manages a setting with persistent storage and React state.

methods.name: usePartitionedState
methods.description: Manages state partitioned by named sections.

methods.name: togglePartition
methods.description: Switches the current partition and restores state accordingly.

methods.name: sha1
methods.description: Computes SHA-1 hash of a string asynchronously.

methods.name: scrollIntoViewIfNeeded
methods.description: Scrolls an element into view if it's not already visible.

methods.name: useFlash
methods.description: Manages flash animation state, triggering a temporary flash effect.
